text:
maya: Heads-up — need to align on retention + HSM prioritization for next quarter. Customer asks piling up. Meeting sync? :calendar:
owen: +1. We have 3 enterprise customers asking for 7y retention + HSM-backed keys. SOC2 wants immutable audit logs. Need scope.
julia: can we split into 2 phases? (1) audit log retention and exportability, (2) HSM integration + KMS policy. Minimizes blast radius.
samir: Phase 1 acceptance: exportable logs, tamper-evident, 90/180/365 retention presets, legal hold API. Phase 2 acceptance: FIPS-compliant HSM integration, rotation workflow, key provenance. Risks: vendor onboarding + infra changes.
alina: legal: 7y retention is doable but requires cost model and opt-in. Also, privacy/regulatory limits in EU. Need data residency controls.
owen: ops: PSA — HSM procurement lead time ~8-10 weeks. If we want HSM in Q3, need vendor selection now.
maya: prioritization: what should be the launch criteria for Q3? Minimal acceptable to ship for enterprise?
julia: proposed launch criteria: audit logs stored immutable for 90 days, export API, encryption-at-rest with KMS, documented legal hold; HSM alpha with one vendor and non-prod integration.
samir: agree, add: e2e tests for log integrity, perf within 10% latency overhead, migration plan.
maya: customer asks: @acme-corp wants monthly rollover + ability to pull raw logs for audits. @banking-client requires HSM+SOC2 evidence.
alina: add compliance checklist: SOC2 control mapping, KMS/HSM evidence, retention policy docs, privacy impact.
owen: timeline: vendor RFP next week, spike on HSM prototype (2 weeks), audit-log export work (3 sprints).
maya: action items: maya -> own roadmap PR with split phases; owen -> RFP + infra estimate; julia -> spec for export + legal hold; samir -> test plan; alina -> compliance checklist. Sync Wed 10am. :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: Meeting scheduled by maya at 2026-04-01T10:00Z
owen: noted. I'll throw preliminary cost estimates into the doc before EOD Tue.
julia: I'll draft the API contract. sample retention configs:
```
retention_policy:
  preset: monthly-archive
  retention_days: 2555 # 7 years
  legal_hold: true
```

samir: quick Q: do we want to support per-tenant retention or only org-level?
alina: legal prefers per-tenant opt-ins with admin controls.
maya: final note: keep scope thin for Q3 to reduce delivery risk. HSM alpha ok. We'll aim HSM GA in later quarter.
